<http://ecoevojobs.net/> is a great website that tracks available jobs in (largely) academia for people with a PhD in evolution, ecology, and related fields. It has info on the timeline of searches, often insider information on what conditions are like at the institution (is the job available because they keep firing professors or due to a recent exciting expansion?) and more. It's a Google Sheet that gets a lot of traffic and represents tremendous community service by "Anonymous Potato", the person who moderates the site (see an interview with them [here](https://dynamicecology.wordpress.com/2024/04/15/a-very-brief-interview-with-ecoevojobs-net-organizer-and-moderator-anonymous-potato/)).

I have here just the first few columns from the site in a reactive table for both Faculty/Permanent Jobs and Postdoc jobs so that you can sort or filter jobs here without affecting the sorting for anyone else. The jobs are refreshed when you load the page (so don't just leave a tab open and assume it'll get new info automatically). Go to <http://ecoevojobs.net/> for more information on each job. You can type in the "Search" box to filter (for example, type "Open" to match "Open Rank" and "Rank Open" jobs). Folks considering applying to these jobs might also be interested in my <https://collegetables.info> site, which has info on faculty trends, majors, location, and much more for nearly all US colleges and universities.

<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.6/css/jquery.dataTables.min.css">
<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.7.1.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.6/js/jquery.dataTables.min.js"></script>

<script>
(function () {
  const pendingLoads = [];
  let activeLoad = false;

  function queueSheetLoad(loadFn) {
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      pendingLoads.push({ loadFn: loadFn, resolve: resolve, reject: reject });
      if (!activeLoad) {
        runQueue();
      }
    });
  }

  function runQueue() {
    if (activeLoad || pendingLoads.length === 0) {
      return;
    }

    activeLoad = true;
    const item = pendingLoads.shift();

    Promise.resolve()
      .then(item.loadFn)
      .then(function (data) {
        item.resolve(data);
      })
      .catch(function (error) {
        item.reject(error);
      })
      .finally(function () {
        activeLoad = false;
        if (pendingLoads.length > 0) {
          runQueue();
        }
      });
  }

  window.ecoevoJobsQueue = window.ecoevoJobsQueue || queueSheetLoad;

  function formatValue(value, columnIndex, columnLabel) {
    if (value === null || value === undefined) {
      return '';
    }

    if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && 'v' in value) {
      return formatValue(value.v, columnIndex, columnLabel);
    }

    if (value instanceof Date) {
      return value.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    }

    const normalizedLabel = (columnLabel || '').toLowerCase().replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '');
    const isReviewDate = normalizedLabel.indexOf('review') !== -1 && normalizedLabel.indexOf('date') !== -1;

    if ((columnIndex === 0 || columnIndex === 4 || isReviewDate) && typeof value === 'string') {
      const match = value.match(/^Date\((\d{4}),\s*(\d{1,2}),\s*(\d{1,2})(?:,\s*\d{1,2},\s*\d{1,2},\s*\d{1,2})?\)$/);
      if (match) {
        const year = parseInt(match[1], 10);
        const month = parseInt(match[2], 10) + 1;
        const day = parseInt(match[3], 10);
        return String(year).padStart(4, '0') + '-' + String(month).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(day).padStart(2, '0');
      }
    }

    if (typeof value === 'string') {
      return value.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    }

    return String(value);
  }

  function initTable(tableId, sheetUrl) {
    const tableEl = document.getElementById(tableId);
    const statusEl = tableEl ? tableEl.parentElement.querySelector('em') : null;

    function loadJobs() {
      return window.ecoevoJobsQueue(function () {
        return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
          window.google = window.google || {};
          window.google.visualization = window.google.visualization || {};
          window.google.visualization.Query = window.google.visualization.Query || {};

          window.google.visualization.Query.setResponse = function (data) {
            resolve(data);
          };

          const script = document.createElement('script');
          script.src = sheetUrl;
          script.async = true;
          script.onload = function () {
            if (!window.google || !window.google.visualization || !window.google.visualization.Query) {
              reject(new Error('The Google Sheets script did not initialize correctly.'));
            }
          };
          script.onerror = function () {
            reject(new Error('Unable to load the Google Sheet script.'));
          };
          document.head.appendChild(script);
        });
      });
    }

    function renderJobs(data) {
      const cols = (data.table && data.table.cols || []).slice(0, 8);
      const shouldHideLastUpdate = tableId === 'ecoevo-postdocs-table';

      const visibleCols = cols.filter(function (col) {
        const label = (col.label || col.id || '').replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '').trim();
        return !(shouldHideLastUpdate && label.toLowerCase() === 'last update');
      });

      const rows = (data.table && data.table.rows || []).map(function (row) {
        const sourceCells = row.c || [];
        const cells = [];

        cols.forEach(function (col, originalIndex) {
          const label = (col.label || col.id || '').replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '');
          if (shouldHideLastUpdate && label.toLowerCase() === 'last update') {
            return;
          }
          cells.push(formatValue(sourceCells[originalIndex], originalIndex, label));
        });

        return cells;
      });

      const displayCols = visibleCols.map(function (col) {
        const label = (col.label || col.id || '').replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '');
        const normalized = label.toLowerCase();

        if (normalized.indexOf('institution') !== -1) {
          return 'Institution';
        }
        if (normalized.indexOf('url') !== -1) {
          return 'URL';
        }
        return label;
      });

      const urlColumnIndex = visibleCols.findIndex(function (col) {
        const label = (col.label || col.id || '').replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '').toLowerCase();
        return label.indexOf('url') !== -1;
      });

      const resolvedUrlColumnIndex = urlColumnIndex === -1 ? 5 : urlColumnIndex;

      const thead = tableEl.querySelector('thead tr');
      thead.innerHTML = displayCols.map(function (label) {
        return '<th>' + label + '</th>';
      }).join('');

      const tbody = tableEl.querySelector('tbody');
      tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(function (row) {
        return '<tr>' + row.map(function (cell, index) {
          if (index === resolvedUrlColumnIndex && typeof cell === 'string' && cell) {
            return '<td><a href="' + cell + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Link</a></td>';
          }
          return '<td>' + cell + '</td>';
        }).join('') + '</tr>';
      }).join('');

      if (statusEl) {
        statusEl.remove();
      }

      if ($.fn.DataTable.isDataTable(tableEl)) {
        $(tableEl).DataTable().destroy();
      }

      $(tableEl).DataTable({
        pageLength: 10,
        order: [[0, 'desc']],
        dom: '<"top"f>rt<"bottom"lip><"clear">',
        responsive: true
      });
    }

    function init() {
      if (!tableEl) {
        return;
      }

      loadJobs()
        .then(renderJobs)
        .catch(function (error) {
          console.error(error);
          if (statusEl) {
            statusEl.textContent = 'Unable to load the jobs table right now.';
          }
        });
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
    } else {
      init();
    }
  }

  initTable(
    'ecoevo-jobs-table',
    'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1P7BfU0emdcGFVIWIs_erFxyy0UGXXORw7h0rpU19gQ8/gviz/tq?tqx=out:json&gid=1219796980'
  );

  initTable(
    'ecoevo-postdocs-table',
    'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1P7BfU0emdcGFVIWIs_erFxyy0UGXXORw7h0rpU19gQ8/gviz/tq?tqx=out:json&gid=1228591705'
  );
}());
</script>

This [StackOverflow answer](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/27764318/extracting-data-from-google-spreadsheet-into-a-html-table) by [Stevie Howard](https://stackoverflow.com/users/4836062/stevie-howard) was used to get the appropriate URL from <http://ecoevojobs.net/>. A VSCode local agent (gemma4) was used to help create the javascript code to filter the table and pass it to dataTables for formatting.
